description: This file defines the ContentImageGet interface, which extends the ImageGet interface and specifies methods for retrieving images and image names associated with a merchant store.

classes.name: ContentImageGet
classes.description: An interface for content image retrieval operations, extending ImageGet and providing methods to get images and image names.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image as OutputContentFile for the specified merchant store, image name, and content type.

methods.name: getImageNames
methods.description: Fetches a list of image names associated with the merchant store for a given content type.
